docs.title: Insolvenzbekanntmachung: Tessin Polymer SA
docs.text: Amtsgericht Muenchen - Insolvenzbekanntmachung. Insolvency proceedings (Insolvenzverfahren) have been opened over the assets of Tessin Polymer SA. Creditors are requested to file their claims with the appointed administrator.
